decisions.reason: The glass flake system extends the firm's established two-component spraying line. Keeping it costs little given in-house manufacturing, and its demand in heavy corrosion protection markets is still uncertain, so the option is worth holding open.
The low-pressure injection pump has its own page and documented field use on construction sites since testing. That evidence reduces uncertainty in its favor and justifies further commitment.
The transfer pump reuses proven air motors, so its marginal cost of staying on the market is low. It fits the core conveying offer, so there is no reason to abandon it.
Fire protection flow monitoring has its own page and supports the firm's digitalization direction. Its value is still uncertain, but keeping it is cheap, so the option should stay open.
The hydraulic two-component system was launched only in 2024 and sits close to the core offer. It is far too early to judge, and keeping it costs little.
